title: Sega Flash Vol. 3
overview:
Volume 3 of Sega's European Sega Flash demo disc series, offering a sampler of Saturn games.

Playable demos:
- Daytona USA Championship Circuit Edition
- Virtual-On: Cyber Troopers
- Tomb Raider
- Sega Worldwide Soccer '97

Non-playable demos:
- Fighting Vipers
- Virtua Cop 2
- Dark Savior
- Nights into Dreams...
- Mr. Bones
- Bug Too!
